character.body_and_colors: Massive top-heavy gorilla torso, broad shoulders, long heavy arms reaching the ground, three short stocky legs; one material of short black fur over flat grey skin. Palette of five flat colours: black fur, flat NPC grey (skin and back saddle), white (sclera, teeth, swooshes), bright blue (sneakers) and warm brown (wooden bat only). Fur drawn in clean chunky tufts, skin perfectly flat, thin confident black outlines.
character.face: Pepe the Frog's big round white eyes with heavy half-closed upper lids give a sleepy-smug stare; thin tilted Wojak worry-brows sit just above them on a flat NPC-grey brow ridge; Doge's short black muzzle with black nose and flared cheek tufts leads down to Trollface's enormous crooked toothy grin that stretches past the cheeks, which in turn is framed by Gigachad's razor-square jaw, sharp cheekbones and short black trimmed beard. Expression: supreme unearned confidence with a tiny flicker of doubt.
character.form: A hulking Harambe silverback gorilla with a black-furred Doge Shiba head, Pepe the Frog's heavy-lidded eyes under Wojak's worried brows, a Trollface grin cut across a bearded Gigachad jaw, NPC Wojak flat grey skin, standing on Tralalero Tralala's three blue-sneakered legs and shouldering Tung Tung Tung Sahur's wooden bat.
character.pose: Standing tall on three sneakers in a slight three-quarter turn, Shiba head cocked back over the shoulder, bat resting on one shoulder, the other knuckles on the ground.
character.vibe: Unearned supreme confidence with a hint of doubt

credits.contribution: The winning backbone: Harambe gorilla base, Doge Shiba ears and cheek tufts in black fur, Pepe lids, Wojak worry-brows, Trollface grin over Gigachad jaw, NPC grey skin, three sneakers and the shouldered bat; only its Gigachad profile pose was swapped for Doge's over-the-shoulder look to strengthen Doge.

Rejected as base: the Wojak torso with gorilla arms repeats the recent Wojak-type silhouettes and the grey Pepe frog head stacked on a Gigachad jaw reads as pasted parts; its clean 'Doge over-the-shoulder pose' idea was adopted.
Rejected: Wojak base with cream Doge fur is coherent but the same stick-body-plus-gorilla-arms recipe as B, E and G; its scribbly Trollface wrinkle folds at the grin corners were kept as detail.
Rejected as incomplete: Harambe base similar to the final, but it omits Wojak, NPC Wojak and Tung Tung Tung Sahur and gives almost no drawing instructions.
Rejected: the all-wood material on a Wojak body is too close to the recent [REDACTED_PRIOR_PROJECT] build (Sahur wood palette); its wide tripod stance idea for the three sneakers was kept.

Rejected: wooden log torso again mirrors [REDACTED_PRIOR_PROJECT] and replaces Harambe's signature long arms with skinny Wojak arms; its strict five-colour discipline inspired the final palette count.
Rejected: very coherent pale-pink Wojak everyman, but another Wojak base; its idea of keeping the bat and brown wood as the only warm accent colour was adopted.

parsed.lore: Brakko is what happens when the whole meme hall of fame tries to share one gym locker. His huge silverback body belongs to Harambe, long arms still dragging on the floor like he never left the enclosure. His head is Doge's Shiba Inu, ears up, cheeks fluffed, cocked back over the shoulder as if he just heard you say something stupid. Under those ears blink Pepe the Frog's heavy sleepy lids, but Wojak's worried little brows sit right above them, so the smug never quite hides the panic. His lower face is pure contradiction: Trollface's crooked wall of teeth stretched across a Gigachad jaw, chiselled, bearded, immovable. His skin is NPC Wojak grey because he has stopped having opinions, only reactions. He stands on Tralalero Tralala's three blue sneakers and rests Tung Tung Tung Sahur's wooden bat on his shoulder. Seven AI labs designed him together, each arguing for a different body, and the internet needs him because he is every reply-guy at once: confident, doubtful, grinning, armed and absolutely not skipping leg day.
parsed.merge_prompt: ONE single cartoon meme character, full body, centered, one body and one face, every part fused into the body and not pasted on, no collage. Base body: the huge black-furred silverback gorilla body of Harambe with long heavy arms reaching the ground and a flat grey saddle across the broad back. Head: the Shiba Inu head of Doge with small triangular upright ears, round fluffy cheek tufts, short muzzle and black nose, covered in the same black fur as the body. Eyes: Pepe the Frog's big round eyes with large white sclera and heavy half-closed sleepy-smug upper lids. Brows: Wojak's thin tilted sad worried eyebrows drawn above the lids on the grey brow ridge. Mouth: the enormous crooked Trollface grin with a full row of big white teeth stretching past the cheeks, with a few scribbly wrinkle folds at the corners. Jaw: Gigachad's extremely chiselled square jawline with sharp cheekbones and a short black trimmed beard, directly under the grin. Skin: all bare skin on face, brow, chest and palms is NPC Wojak's flat featureless grey with no shading. Feet: three short stocky black-furred legs in a wide tripod, each wearing a bright blue Nike-style sneaker with a white swoosh like Tralalero Tralala. Accessory: Tung Tung Tung Sahur's polished warm-brown wooden baseball bat with grain rings resting on one shoulder. Pose: the body in a slight three-quarter turn, the Shiba head cocked and turned back over the shoulder like Doge, one hand holding the bat, the other knuckles on the ground. Signature feature: the bearded Gigachad jaw with a Trollface grin on a Shiba-headed gorilla standing on three blue sneakers. One consistent palette of exactly five flat colours: black fur, flat grey skin and saddle, white teeth sclera and swooshes, bright blue sneakers, warm brown bat. Style: clean character illustration, confident thin black lineart, flat colours with at most minimal flat shading, chunky clean fur tufts, expressive face, solid single-colour pale yellow background; no shadows, no gradients, no lighting effects, no floor, no background elements, no text, no logos, no watermark.
parsed.tagline: Three sneakers, one jaw, zero doubts. Mostly.

You are the Director of the Merge Meme Council. You receive the builds of up to seven AI labs for ONE new meme character
fused from famous meme characters. Choose the strongest build or combine the best slot choices into one: the result must show a
recognisable part of EVERY source meme (head, eyes, mouth, jaw, body, feet, accessory, pose, palette...) and still be ONE coherent
being with one body, one material and one consistent palette, with a brand-new one-word name. Answer with ONE strict JSON object and nothing else.

Source memes and their signature traits:
- Doge (base: Shiba Inu dog)
    head: Shiba Inu head: round fluffy cheeks, short muzzle, small triangular upright ears, cream-and-tan fur, black nose
    eyes: the Doge look: eyes shifted to the side in a sideways side-eye, raised inner eyebrows, calm judging stare
    pose: head tilted and turned over the shoulder, viewed from a slight three-quarter angle
    palette: cream, tan and white fur with a dark nose
- Pepe the Frog (base: green cartoon frog)
    mouth: Pepe lips: thick, wide reddish-brown lips in a flat smug line across the whole lower face
    eyes: big round eyes with heavy half-closed upper lids and large white sclera, sleepy-smug
    head: wide flat frog head, no neck, eyes sitting on top
    palette: Pepe green skin with reddish-brown lips
- Trollface (base: black-and-white scribble face)
    mouth: Trollface grin: enormous crooked grin stretching past the cheeks, a full row of big visible teeth
    head: lumpy, wrinkly, dented rounded head with scribbly wobbling outline
    eyes: small squinting mischievous eyes with heavy folds under them
    style: rough black-and-white MS-Paint scribble lineart
- Wojak (base: pale bald cartoon man)
    body: Wojak body: thin pale pink human body, narrow slumped shoulders, simple thin lineart, plain and sad
    head: bald egg-shaped pale head with no hair, big smooth forehead
    face: sad furrowed brows, tiny downturned mouth, blank worried stare
    palette: flat pale pink skin and thin black outlines
- Gigachad (base: black-and-white sculpted man)
    jaw: Gigachad jaw: extremely chiselled square jawline and sharp cheekbones with a short dark trimmed beard
    body: thick neck, massive broad shoulders and chest, sculpted muscles
    pose: chin raised, head turned to the side in profile, confident smirk
    style: high-contrast black-and-white, sculpted, statue-like look
    hair: slicked-back dark hair
- Harambe (base: silverback gorilla)
    body: silverback gorilla build: huge dark-furred body, long heavy arms, grey silver back
    face: calm, serious gorilla face with deep-set eyes and a heavy brow ridge
    palette: black fur with a silver-grey back and dark grey skin
- Tralalero Tralala (base: shark with three legs in sneakers)
    feet: Tralalero sneakers: three legs each wearing a bright blue Nike-style sneaker with a white swoosh
    head: grey-blue shark head with pointed snout, small black eye, open mouth with small teeth
    body: sleek shark body with dorsal fin and tail fin, standing upright on its legs
    palette: grey-blue shark skin, white belly, bright blue sneakers
- Tung Tung Tung Sahur (base: walking wooden log)
    body: Tung Tung Tung Sahur body: an upright wooden log cylinder, brown polished wood with wood-grain rings, thin wooden arms and legs
    accessory: a wooden baseball bat held in one hand
    eyes: huge wide round staring eyes with a creepy smile on a flat wooden face
    palette: warm orange-brown wood tones
- NPC Wojak (base: grey expressionless man)
    face: NPC face: completely blank expression, two dot eyes, straight line mouth, pointed nose
    palette: flat grey skin, no colour at all
    head: bald grey head, simple outline, no detail
